_comment: Who is who. Keyed by graph id (= file name without .json). 'hook' says how much of the NPC's talk the graph controls: full = the whole conversation; greeting = only the spoken part before a C# shop/sell menu; none = no graph hook yet. 'entryNodes' = extra nodes the script starts at by name (count as roots). Entries without a file show up greyed out.

npc_tev.name: Tev
npc_tev.where: Humble Abode — outside his cabin (the music shop)

probes.traxOwned: TRAX is installed on the shuttle computer, or the player carries an unspent stick
probes.canCarryStick: the hotbar has room for one more USB stick

actions.grantStarterBlanks: 3 blank demo tapes into the hotbar (best effort)
actions.openShop: opens Tev's plugin shop when the talk ends

npc_tev.notes: Flag tevMet = has answered the pitch once. TRAX is $20 (MoneyAtLeast 20 / SpendMoney 20 in the graph).

npc_floorbin.name: Floorbin
npc_floorbin.where: Humble Abode — the PARENT marker (authored NPC)
npc_floorbin.notes: Lost-kid quest parent. Flags: floorbin_name_learned → shllorbin_following → shllorbin_returned → bounty_spot_known. The reunion celebration force-starts his talk (returned + not thanked).

npc_shllorbin.name: Shllorbin
npc_shllorbin.where: Humble Abode — the KID marker (authored NPC)

probes.kidFollowing: he is currently following the player (live quest state, not a saved flag)

npc_shllorbin.notes: Only trusts you once floorbin_name_learned is set (Floorbin's first talk).

actions.firstTimeReward: marks first meeting done, unlocks axe + pistol, offers the axe tutorial after

npc_alien3.name: Alien3 (rod trader)

probes.holdingCassette: the player is holding a cassette right now

actions.tradeRod: takes the cassette, gives the fishing rod, ends the talk for good

npc_alien3.notes: Once tradeRod fires he never offers the talk prompt again (saved).

npc_guitarshop.name: Guitar Shop

actions.giveGuitar: equips the guitar; the shop is Done after this talk

npc_guitarshop.notes: Money is in the graph: MoneyAtLeast + SpendMoney. The 50/50 haggle is a Chance route.

npc_alien7.name: Goods Vendor
npc_alien7.notes: Only the spoken greeting is in the graph. The Open shop / sell / Leave menu after it is C#.

npc_shipmarket.name: Ship Vendor
npc_shipmarket.notes: Only the spoken greeting is in the graph. The shop menu after it is C#.

npc_fishmarket.name: Fish Vendor

probes.bountyTurnedIn: the GRULABU bounty has been paid

npc_fishmarket.notes: Two entry points: node 'start' = greeting before the sell menu; node 'bounty' = what he says when you pick 'Ask about the bounty'. The sell/bait/turn-in menu is C#.

npc_alien6.name: Alien6 (random small-talk)
npc_alien6.where: NOT PLACED in the gameplay scene right now
npc_alien6.notes: Script exists but no object in 1.6.7.7.7.unity uses it. Lines live in the Inspector.

npc_shipinstructor.name: Ship Instructor
npc_shipinstructor.notes: Mission 1 pilot test; not in the live scene. Lines live in the Inspector.

conv_first_contact.name: First contact
conv_first_contact.notes: HAL's opening conversation on the phone.

conv_village_arrival.name: Village arrival
conv_village_arrival.notes: Queued when the player reaches the village.

conv_gates.name: Story gates
conv_gates.notes: Started at a node id (e.g. gate_explore) by StoryDirector.
